description: This file defines the ModelPermission class in the org.apache.ofbiz.service package. It manages service permissions, including evaluation and validation logic, for the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ModelPermission
classes.description: A class representing permissions associated with services, including evaluation logic for different permission types within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: evalPermission
methods.description: Evaluates whether the specified permission is granted based on user login and context.

methods.name: evalSimplePermission
methods.description: Checks a simple permission against the security system.

methods.name: evalEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks an entity permission against the security system.

methods.name: setPermissionServiceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission service.

methods.name: setPermissionMainAction
methods.description: Sets the main action for the permission.

methods.name: setPermissionResourceDesc
methods.description: Sets the description of the permission resource.

methods.name: setPermissionRequireNewTransaction
methods.description: Specifies whether the permission evaluation requires a new transaction.

methods.name: setPermissionReturnErrorOnFailure
methods.description: Configures whether to return an error on permission failure.

methods.name: setNameOrRole
methods.description: Sets the name or role associated with the permission.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Defines the action associated with the permission.

methods.name: getPERMISSION
methods.description: Returns the constant representing simple permission type.

methods.name: getEntityPermission
methods.description: Returns the constant representing entity permission type.

methods.name: getPermissionService
methods.description: Returns the constant representing permission service type.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action associated with the permission.

methods.name: setServiceModel
methods.description: Sets the ModelService associated with this permission.

methods.name: evalPermissionService
methods.description: Evaluates permission via a specified service model and dispatch context.
